evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: We introduce GPS-Bench, an evidence-grounded benchmark for governance policy simulation that links policies to relevant actors, actor actions and downstream impacts using legislative records, lobbying disclosures, regulatory documents, corporate filings, economic data and other public evidence.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: LLM-based policy simulations model these processes at scale, but their validity is hard to establish when plausible behaviour is never compared with observed outcomes.

evidence.label: 讨论泛化、污染、稳健性或人工核验
evidence.excerpt: Actors are reconstructed from the dated record rather than prompted as archetypes, so a persona is an evidence object with provenance; a human-annotated pool forms the Gold evaluation set, while cases labelled by a separate LLM from retrieved evidence are treated as Silver supervision and never as test labels.
